## Citibike Prediction Testing 
```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(modelr)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(here)
options(na.action = na.warn)
library(broom)

theme_set(theme_bw())
```



``` {r load-trips}

trips_2015 <- read_tsv(here('week4','trips_per_day_2015.tsv'))
trips_2015 <- trips_2015 %>% mutate(month = format(ymd, "%b"))
head(trips_2015)

weather_2015 <- read_csv(here('week4','weather_2015.csv'))
weather <- rename(weather_2015, station=STATION, name=NAME, ymd=DATE , prcp=PRCP, snow=SNOW, snwd=SNWD, tavg=TAVG, tmax=TMAX, tmin=TMIN)
head(weather)



trips_weather <- trips_2015 %>% inner_join(weather)
trips_weather <- trips_weather %>% mutate(tmin = tmin*0.1,tmax = tmax *0.1)
head(trips_weather)

load('C:/Users/farida/coursework/week3/predict_citibike.RData')

```

```{r model-predictions}
summary(model)
rmse(model, trips_weather)
rsquare(model, trips_weather)

```
